messages:
Nikhil P: Quick heads-up from a customer onboarding call: the Python quickstart references a REST endpoint /v1/models/versions but the Python SDK exposes client.models.versions_list() with different param names so the sample app errors out.

Nikhil P: REST curl in quickstart that works:
```bash
curl -X GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/versions?model=llama-3-8b \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY'
```

Nikhil P: Python SDK attempt from sample app (fails):
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
# sample app expects this
c.models.versions(model='llama-3-8b')
# -> AttributeError: 'Models' object has no attribute 'versions'
```

Claire S: Ugh. Looks like naming drift again: SDK uses list_versions(model_id=...) and returns keys named 'version_id' not 'id'. Sample app parses 'id' so it crashes downstream.

Yosuke: Confirmed locally. Also hit an auth quirk: when token is rotated mid-run the SDK raises immediately instead of retrying, while our infra gateway does an automatic refresh/retry for short-lived keys. That makes the sample app flaky in long-running onboarding demos.

Nikhil P: Customer workaround: use direct HTTP call in sample app or call c._raw.get('/v1/models/versions', params={'model':'llama-3-8b'}) — ugly but works. Need a proper fix.

Claire S: Created ticket INF-7412 with repro and suggested SDK API compatibility wrapper: add models.versions(alias) and normalize response keys to include 'id'. Also request auth middleware change to align retry semantics.

devex-bot: Issue created: INF-7412 — "Python SDK parity: model versions endpoint + auth retry mismatch" (<https://issues.redwood.ai/INF-7412>) by Claire S

eng-ml-oncall: For an immediate patch we can add a shim in the Python SDK that accepts both param names and returns the older key names for backwards compatibility. I'll schedule a small 1.0.1 release.

Claire S: I'll update the quickstart PR to mention the temporary shim and include the raw-curl fallback. Also adding a note to the sample app tests so CI fails if SDK surface changes again.

Nikhil P: Thanks — that should stop another confused customer call. If somebody can post the exact exception trace into INF-7412 I'll attach it to the ticket.
